prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1071; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of lower back pain and stiffness radiating into the left buttock. The mechanism of the impact and the force involved are consistent with the injury described. Examination on intake revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness, restricted lumbar range of motion, and muscle guarding, and imaging obtained during the initial evaluation clearly confirmed soft tissue injury to the lumbar region. The patient also reported a minor strain to the same area several years ago, which had resolved completely without lasting limitation. Over 15 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, guided stretching, and a home exercise program. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency reduced as symptoms and mobility improved. At discharge the patient had regained near-full range of motion and reported minimal residual discomfort. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no duplicated charges.
